title: Text-based inference of moral sentiment change
findings: The framework was used to automatically discover concepts with the greatest change in moral sentiment over time. Among the top 10 words showing increased moral relevance between 1800-2000 were the religious terms 'apostle' and 'jew'. The model inferred that 'apostle' became associated with the 'authority+' moral category and 'jew' with the 'degradation-' category, identifying specific historical switching periods for these changes.
